tools.description: Get the full verse/fractal/petal/node hierarchy, filtered to the token scope. Requires viewer role.
tools.name: get_hierarchy

tools.description: Create a new verse. Requires manager role (verses have no parent scope).
tools.name: create_verse

tools.description: Create a fractal in an existing verse; a fractal_id or petal_id in the args is rejected (would escalate past the verse anchor). Requires editor role + the verse's scope.
tools.name: create_fractal

tools.description: Create a petal in an existing fractal; authorized against the fractal's stored hierarchy (verse_id, if sent, must match it; a petal_id in the args is rejected). Requires editor role + scope.

fractal_id.description: Parent fractal (its stored verse is the authz anchor)

verse_id.description: Optional; must match the fractal's stored verse

tools.name: create_petal

tools.description: Create an empty node in an existing petal; authorized against the petal's stored hierarchy (verse_id/fractal_id, if sent, must match it). Requires editor role + scope.

fractal_id.description: Optional; must match the petal's stored fractal

petal_id.description: Parent petal (its stored hierarchy is the authz anchor)

position.description: [x, y, z] in world units (meters × the petal map's world_scale; 1 world unit = 1 m when world_scale is 1)

verse_id.description: Optional; must match the petal's stored verse

tools.name: create_node

tools.description: Update a node's position, rotation, and scale (persisted asynchronously, broadcast to live subscribers). Requires editor role + the node's scope.

position.description: [x, y, z] in world units (meters × the petal map's world_scale; 1 world unit = 1 m when world_scale is 1)

rotation.description: [x, y, z] Euler angles in radians, XYZ order (the in-app inspector displays degrees)

scale.description: [x, y, z] unitless scale multipliers (1.0 = authored size)

tools.name: update_transform

tools.description: Read an object's full payload by node id (common fields + type-specific stamp/earthwork/path data). Tombstoned nodes read as not found. Requires viewer role + scope.

node_id.description: Node ULID or promoted-stamp instance id (<ulid>#inst-<n>)

tools.name: read_node

tools.description: Read a bounded durable object journal page with coverage metadata and per-object commit versions. Requires viewer role and current or retained object scope.
tools.name: get_node_history

tools.description: Replay one exact object commit version, with explicit unavailable/incomplete coverage. Requires viewer role and current or retained object scope.
tools.name: read_node_at_version

tools.description: Commit a typed property replacement/removal or full transform and return persisted state plus history_version. Requires editor role and object scope.

mutation.description: Tagged op: property_set {key,value}, property_deleted {key}, full_transform {position,rotation,scale}; rotation radians

tools.name: commit_node_mutation

tools.description: Resolve a node id to its stable fe://verse/fractal/petal/node endpoint URI. Requires viewer role + scope.
tools.name: node_address

tools.description: Sync-safe tombstone delete of a node (never a raw drop; survives P2P merge). Set cascade=true to tombstone the whole subtree atomically. Requires editor role + scope; authorized by fe-policy.

cascade.description: Tombstone the node's whole descendant subtree in one atomic op

tools.name: delete_node

tools.description: Materialize a full addressable node for a single stamp instance (lazy promotion, idempotent). Requires editor role + petal scope; authorized by fe-policy.

instance_index.description: Zero-based instance index within the stamp group

path_id.description: Owning path node id whose curve the stamp follows

tools.name: promote_instance

tools.description: Run a distributed timeseries query over a petal's sharded IoT fabric. The query fans out to online peers hosting the petal's shards and merges commutatively (aggregate: mean/min/max/count as an exact monoid; raw rows: union deduped by reading_id; latest: max timestamp per anchor). Results carry covered/missing shard honesty metadata — an offline peer's shards are invisible at replication factor 1, served from a surviving mirror at R>=2. Requires viewer role + petal scope.

end_ms.description: Window end, epoch ms exclusive (required for window_aggregate and readings_in_window)

kind.description: Query shape: window_aggregate = per-anchor mean/min/max/count over a half-open [start_ms, end_ms) window; latest_per_anchor = newest reading per (anchor, metric); readings_in_window = raw rows in the window; all_readings = the whole merged view of the petal

metric.description: Metric name (required for window_aggregate and readings_in_window; optional filter for latest_per_anchor)

petal_id.description: The petal whose shard fabric is queried

start_ms.description: Window start, epoch ms inclusive (required for window_aggregate and readings_in_window)

tools.name: query_timeseries

tools.description: Upload a GLB (binary glTF 2.0, textures embedded) as base64; stored content-addressed (BLAKE3) and registered as an asset row. Max 11 MiB decoded over MCP (the /mcp body cap is 16 MiB); larger GLBs (up to 256 MiB) go through REST multipart POST /api/v1/petals/{petal_id}/assets. Returns {asset_id, content_hash, size_bytes}. Requires editor role + the anchor petal's scope.

petal_id.description: Authz anchor petal (asset rows themselves are node-global)

tools.name: upload_asset

tools.description: Create a node in a petal bound to an uploaded asset_id, at position (world units) with Euler XYZ rotation (radians) and scale. The asset must have been uploaded to a petal within the token's scope, or already be used by a node within it (a legacy asset with no upload petal may also be unplaced). Requires editor role + petal scope.

position.description: [x, y, z] in world units (meters × the petal map's world_scale; 1 world unit = 1 m when world_scale is 1)

rotation.description: [x, y, z] Euler angles in radians, XYZ order (the in-app inspector displays degrees)

scale.description: [x, y, z] unitless scale multipliers (1.0 = authored size)

tools.name: place_asset

tools.description: Set one custom property (any JSON value) on a node. Requires editor role + the node's scope.

value.description: Any non-null JSON value (use delete_property to remove)

tools.name: set_property

tools.description: Read all custom properties of a node. Requires viewer role + the node's scope.
tools.name: get_properties

tools.description: Read a field's enforced property schema and immutable revision list. Requires viewer role and the stored definition scope.
tools.name: get_field_schema

tools.description: Install the next bounded property-schema revision after validating current values. No implicit defaults or migrations. Requires manager role and stored definition scope.
tools.name: set_field_schema

tools.description: Delete one custom property from a node. Requires editor role + the node's scope.
tools.name: delete_property

tools.description: Create a waypoint node at WGS84 lat/lon/ele, projected through the petal's terrain origin. Requires editor role + petal scope.
tools.name: create_waypoint

tools.description: Move a waypoint node to a new WGS84 lat/lon (ele optional), reprojecting its transform. Requires editor role + the node's scope.
tools.name: move_waypoint

tools.description: Import a GPX document (base64, max 11 MiB decoded, max 10000 points) as track/waypoint nodes in a petal. Requires editor role + petal scope.
tools.name: import_gpx

tools.description: Set (object) or clear (null) a petal's terrain config, like REST PUT/DELETE /petals/{id}/terrain. The object must be a valid TerrainConfig; returns the stored terrain. Requires editor role + petal scope.

terrain.description: A TerrainConfig object, or null to clear

tools.name: set_petal_terrain

tools.description: Set (>= 0) or clear (null) a petal's durable residency horizon (petal.render_distance; replicates to peers), like REST PUT/DELETE /petals/{id}/render-distance. Returns the stored value. Requires editor role + petal scope.

render_distance.description: World units, >= 0; null clears it (inherit the global setting)

tools.name: set_petal_render_distance

tools.description: List a petal's visibility Groups ({id, name, visible, order}), like REST GET /petals/{id}/visibility-groups. Requires viewer role + petal scope.
tools.name: list_visibility_groups

tools.description: Upsert one visibility Group (name/visible/order; a new group needs a name) or delete it (delete: true), like REST PATCH/DELETE /petals/{id}/visibility-groups/{group_id}. Returns the stored registry. Requires editor role + petal scope; the DB re-checks Editor+ via fe-policy.

group_id.description: Stable Group id (created if absent and a name is given)

tools.name: set_visibility_group

tools.description: List the installed terrain tilesets bound to a petal's terrain config. Requires viewer role + petal scope.
tools.name: list_tilesets

tools.description: Install a .hexon terrain-tileset archive (base64, max 11 MiB decoded — the same cap as the REST install route) already bound only to this petal's terrain. Requires editor role + petal scope; authorized by fe-policy (Install).

petal_id.description: The petal whose terrain already binds this tileset id

tools.name: install_tileset

tools.description: List a petal's geo-positioned nodes with gis.annotation.* data; optional single spatial filter (bbox, bbox_ll, or radius+cx+cz). Requires viewer role + petal scope.

bbox_ll.description: Lat/lon AABB: minLat,minLon,maxLat,maxLon (needs a petal terrain origin)

radius.description: Radius in local meters (with cx + cz)

tools.name: get_gis_nodes

tools.description: Run a read-only SurrealQL SELECT through the /api/v1/query guard pipeline (rate limit, SELECT-only, table whitelist, token-scope filter injection, row/byte caps). Requires viewer role.

sql.description: One read-only SurrealQL SELECT; the token scope filter is injected

tools.name: query

tools.description: Declare a device payload format (format_id + mime + optional informative JSON Schema, never enforced in v1) for a verse; immutable per (verse_id, format_id) — re-declaring the SAME mime is an idempotent success, a DIFFERENT mime is a conflict. Requires manager role + verse scope.

mime.description: MIME every asset ingested under this format must carry

schema.description: Informative JSON Schema for the payload bytes; never enforced in v1

tools.name: register_device_format

tools.description: List every device_format declared for a verse. Requires viewer role + verse scope.
tools.name: list_device_formats

tools.description: Ingest one device payload: base64 files (order preserved into asset_ids; total decoded size <= 11 MiB over MCP, use REST multipart POST /api/v1/petals/{petal_id}/iot/payloads for larger payloads), stored as generic assets under a declared format's mime, then recorded as one device_payload row. Requires editor role + petal scope.

format_id.description: A format already declared via register_device_format

node_id.description: Anchor node the payload is spatially attached to

payload_id.description: Client-supplied id for an idempotent retry

recorded_at.description: RFC-3339 sensor timestamp; server ingest time when absent

tools.name: ingest_device_payload

tools.description: List device_payload rows for a petal, optionally filtered by node_id, format_id and a recorded-time window (from_ms/to_ms). Requires viewer role + petal scope.
tools.name: list_device_payloads

tools.description: Capture the application view as a PNG image. Empty arguments capture the live window exactly like plain GET. A `pose` (exactly one of camera/orbit/geo/tile/focus) and `mode` (window: moves the main camera, settles, restores by default; scene: off-screen render at any width/height, no UI, user's view untouched) move where the capture looks; the response's second content block is the resolved pose JSON. On by default (set FE_API_SCREENSHOT_ALLOW=0 to disable); scope-confined: the token must cover the open verse (uniform not-found otherwise); 1 capture/sec. Requires owner role.

height.description: only with include_ui: false (a UI capture is the window's own size); 64..=4096, default 720

include_ui.description: include_ui (default true): include the app's UI panels in the image; false renders only the 3D scene off-screen without moving the user's view

mode.description: Same switch as include_ui (window = true, scene = false); kept for compatibility. Giving both with different answers is refused (include_ui_conflicts_with_mode).

focus.description: Frames a node's or petal's AABB; exactly one of node_id/petal_id.

navigate.description: only with include_ui: true; navigate into the target's petal (same verse only) first; undone afterwards unless restore is false

tile.description: Frames a Web-Mercator slippy tile (NW(x,y)..NW(x+1,y+1)) through the active petal's terrain projection.

restore.description: only with include_ui: true; default true — puts the camera (and any navigation) back afterwards

settle_frames.description: <=600; default 30 with a pose, 0 for a bare window capture

width.description: only with include_ui: false (a UI capture is the window's own size); 64..=4096, default 1280

tools.name: screenshot

tools.description: Read the live main-camera pose, locked state, active verse/fractal/petal and terrain projection info — pairs with `screenshot`'s pose kinds for a closed read-look loop. Shares the screenshot opt-in (on by default; set FE_API_SCREENSHOT_ALLOW=0 to disable); 10 reads/sec. Requires owner role.
tools.name: get_camera

tools.description: Read the primary window accessibility tree in physical screenshot pixels. Scoped to the active verse; FE_API_INPUT_ALLOW=1 required. Requires owner role.
tools.name: ui_tree

tools.description: Queue bounded open/save/folder answers for QA file dialogs in the active verse. Requires input opt-in, an actual loopback listener and an isolated QA root; paths stay inside that run. Requires owner role.
tools.name: dialog_answers

tools.description: Request QA window size in physical pixels, app UI scale, maximize/restore/minimize, or close confirmation. Requires input opt-in, loopback listener and isolated QA root. Close never bypasses confirmation. Requires owner role.
tools.name: window

tools.description: Read authoritative navigation, selection, tool, viewport, notices and pending state. FE_API_INPUT_ALLOW=1 required. Requires owner role.
tools.name: ui_state

tools.description: Read a bounded, redacted log tail for the current verse generation. FE_API_INPUT_ALLOW=1 required. Requires owner role.
tools.name: ui_logs

tools.description: Synthesize pointer/keyboard/scroll input into the running GUI: a batch of up to 64 commands (pointer_move, pointer_click, pointer_drag, key_press, text_entry, scroll), an optional wait_frames to settle (<=120) and an optional capture_after to attach a PNG of the result (capture_after also needs the screenshot surface on and spends its 1 capture/sec budget). Scope-confined: the token must cover the open verse. OFF by default (set FE_API_INPUT_ALLOW=1 to enable) — unlike the default-on screenshot/camera surfaces, this MUTATES state; combined with them an Owner token gets full remote control. Refused with 409 while a posed capture holds the camera. Control/Super+C/V/X clipboard chords are refused, and text/image clipboard writes from UI controls are suppressed throughout injection and settling, including its final frame; idle user copies remain enabled. Synthetic input never reads or writes the host OS clipboard. 5 requests/sec. Requires owner role.

capture_after.description: attach a PNG of the window after the batch applies; also needs the screenshot surface (FE_API_SCREENSHOT_ALLOW) and its 1 capture/sec budget; default false

commands.description: 1..=64 commands, applied in order; primary-window pixel coordinates (the same space a prior screenshot's PNG dimensions give an agent).

key.description: key_press; a bevy KeyCode variant name, e.g. "Enter", "KeyA", "ArrowLeft" (<=32 ASCII alphanumeric chars)

wait_frames.description: frames to settle before replying; <=120, default 0

tools.name: inject_input

request.sql: SELECT node_id FROM node WHERE petal_id = $p AND properties.qa_fixture = $fixture AND tombstone = NONE
